title: Began M.Sc. in Advanced Optical Technologies (MAOT) at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg
detail: Started graduate studies focusing on computational photonics, light physics, and biomedical optical processing.

title: Joined Max Planck School of Photonics (Cohort 8 Study Phase)
detail: Selected as a Ph.D. candidate in the national photonics fellowship and graduate study program.

title: Co-initiated Optica Egypt Local Section

title: Joined NanoPhoto Lab, IMRE, A*STAR as a research intern
